newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India tenders to buy second June gasoline cargo.
newsitem.headline: India tenders to buy second June gasoline cargo.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a second tender for June supplies of 87-octane leaded gasoline, traders said on Friday.
IOC is seeking another 25,000 tonnes of 87-octane with a lead content of 0.15 grammes per litre for delivery to Bombay on the west coast between June 18-22.
The tender closes June 4 and is valid for a day.
IOC had last week issued its first tender for delivery between June 10-14 which closed May 28 and was valid until May 29.
Sources had said IOC's re-emergence in the spot market was due to normal shortfalls in its system.

IOC had not issued a tender since it bought 90,000-tonnes of 87-octane leaded gasoline for delivery in March to the west coast at $40 per tonne over Mideast naphtha spot quotes on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis or the quivalent of $1 per barrel over Singapore 92-octane gasoline quotes, c-and-f.
